hero.description: FamilyHub uses AI to help families capture, preserve, and share their stories, memories, and wisdom — so the things that matter most are never lost.

features.title: Keep Your Family's Story Alive
features.subtitle: Simple, beautiful tools that make preserving family memories as easy as having a conversation

items.title: Voice Story Recording
items.description: Capture family stories and memories through natural voice conversations — AI transcribes, organizes, and preserves every word.

items.title: Family Knowledge Book
items.description: Automatically compile recorded stories, photos, and memories into a beautiful, shareable digital family book.

items.title: Multi-Generation Access
items.description: Invite family members of all ages to contribute and explore — simple enough for grandparents, engaging for grandchildren.

items.title: AI Conversation Guide
items.description: AI-guided questions help family members share meaningful stories they might not think to tell on their own.

items.title: Photo & Memory Vault
items.description: Upload photos, videos, and documents. AI organizes them by people, places, and events automatically.

items.title: Private & Secure
items.description: Your family stories are private by default. End-to-end encryption ensures only invited family members can access your memories.

quote.text: The stories our grandparents told us are the foundation of who we are. FamilyHub makes sure those stories are never lost.

cta.title: Give Your Family the Gift of Preserved Memories
cta.description: Start capturing stories today — free to try, easy to use, and built to last generations.
